methodology.ranking: Primary rank = DefiLlama measured per-chain DEX 24h volume (total24h from /api/v2/overview/dexs/{chain}). This is a MEASURED number, not an estimate.
methodology.share_method: SAMPLED market-cap share over the CoinGecko top-40 meme-token list (per_page=100&page=1 of /coins/markets?category=meme-token, then the top 40 by market cap). Each token's market cap is assigned to its home chain so bridged copies are not double-counted.

unattributed.reason: native coin: no token contract on any chain (platforms empty); its market cap is the chain's own native asset, not a memecoin token

methodology.caveat: A chain appearing in the ranked list does NOT mean the free endpoints for it work. Step 2 establishes that independently.

coverage_gaps.rugcheck_solana_only: RugCheck served HTTP 200 for the Solana mint report/summary; every EVM address returned HTTP 400 'decode: base58: invalid base58 character', and the chain-prefixed /v1/tokens/{chain}/{addr} form returned HTTP 404.
coverage_gaps.jupiter_solana_only: Jupiter's /tokens/v2/search returned only Solana SPL mints; 0 of 4083 verified-tag results had a 0x-prefixed id, and exact EVM address queries returned 0 results.
coverage_gaps.ankr_pattern_unusable: rpc.ankr.com/<chain> failed TLS hostname verification on this host for all 24 chains tried, and rpc.subquery.network/public/<chain> returned HTTP 404 for all 22.
coverage_gaps.sui_json_rpc_deprecated: Sui's JSON-RPC endpoint returns HTTP 200 with a deprecation error ('Sui JSON-RPC has been deprecated'); the working free endpoint is the GraphQL gateway.
